gloss: female proprietor; hostess; lady of the house

definitions.gloss: female proprietor; hostess; lady of the house
definitions.explanation: a woman who owns or runs an establishment such as a shop, inn, or restaurant, or the female head of a household

examples.japanese: {女主人|おんなしゅじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出迎|でむか}えて→出迎える：04633_demukaeru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The mistress of the house came out to greet us.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{女主人|おんなしゅじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧だった。
examples.english: The female proprietor of the inn was very kind.

examples.japanese: {女主人|おんなしゅじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自|みずか}ら→自ら：00287_mizukara⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}んで→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧きて、⟦{一品|いっぴん}→一品：08919_ippin⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The female proprietor personally brought the dishes and explained each one carefully.

notes:
Used when specifically identifying the owner or head of an establishment or household as a woman. Common in literary contexts and when describing traditional Japanese businesses like ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧ (Japanese inns) or ⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧ (high-end Japanese restaurants).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{女主人|おんなしゅじん}: the female proprietor of an inn
- ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{女主人|おんなしゅじん}: the female shop owner
- {女主人|おんなしゅじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}り{盛|も}り→切り盛り：18640_kirimori⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: for the female proprietor to run (a business)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{女将|おかみ}→女将：12210_okami⟧: proprietress of a traditional inn or restaurant — more specific to the hospitality industry and carries connotations of traditional Japanese service
- ⟦{主人|しゅじん}→主人：00987_shujin⟧: master, proprietor — typically refers to a male owner or husband
- ⟦{亭主|ていしゅ}→亭主：11470_teishu⟧: husband, master of the house — informal, can also mean male innkeeper
